1 // Per-skill band → real-knob mapping tables (NS-01 / Waves 5–6).
2 //
3 // Locked process depth (and model tier where seats matter) must change real
4 // engine knobs — rounds / reviewers / seats / prose ceremony — not just labels.
5 // Inequality across FULL | LITE | SPIKE is tested for every mapped skill.
6 //
7 // B3: BAND_MAPPINGS.jumper is the sole numeric truth for jumper depth →
8 // {ideaRounds, killGates}. SPIKE is a first-class cell. killGates ≥ 3 is a
9 // load-or-init hard floor (never clamp) — see assertJumperKillGatesFloor.
10 //
11 // Wave 5: trio (crucible, foreman, researchPrime) + sample (gandalf).
12 // Wave 6: full 11 (adds jumper, ramanujan, tidy-idy, zombie-hunter,
13 //         literature-review, financial-analyst, legal-beagle).
14 //
15 // Named consumption sites:
16 //   · crucible-wire.mjs  → crucibleKnobs / assessComplexity.bandKnobs
17 //   · foreman-wire.mjs   → foremanKnobs → REVIEWERS_BY_DEPTH
18 //   · researchprime-wire → researchPrimeKnobs → intake extension payload
19 //   · entry-points.mjs   → knobsForSkill for every manifest skill
20 //
21 // Non-goals: DPAPI/sealer; researchPrime governor module (byte-unchanged).
22

332 /**
333  * Load-or-init hard floor for BAND_MAPPINGS.jumper killGates.
334  * Every depth row must expose integer killGates ≥ min. Never clamps — throws.
335  * Used at module init on the live table; tests inject synthetic rows (B3-SC3-LOAD-ASSERT).
336  *
337  * @param {Readonly<Record<string, Readonly<object>>> | Record<string, object>} jumperTable
338  * @param {{ min?: number }} [opts]
339  * @returns {true}
340  */
341 export function assertJumperKillGatesFloor(jumperTable, opts = {}) {
342   const min = Number.isInteger(opts.min) ? opts.min : JUMPER_KILL_GATES_MIN;
343   if (!jumperTable || typeof jumperTable !== 'object') {
344     const err = new Error('BAND_MAPPINGS.jumper missing or not an object');
345     err.name = 'JumperKillGatesFloorError';
346     err.code = 'JUMPER_KILLGATES_FLOOR';
347     throw err;
348   }
349   const depths = Object.keys(jumperTable);
350   if (depths.length === 0) {
351     const err = new Error('BAND_MAPPINGS.jumper has no depth rows');
352     err.name = 'JumperKillGatesFloorError';
353     err.code = 'JUMPER_KILLGATES_FLOOR';
354     throw err;
355   }
356   for (const depth of depths) {
357     const row = jumperTable[depth];
358     const kg = row && /** @type {{ killGates?: unknown }} */ (row).killGates;
359     // Hard fail — never Math.max/clamp a thinned value up to the floor.
360     if (!Number.isInteger(kg) || /** @type {number} */ (kg) < min) {
361       const err = new Error(
362         `BAND_MAPPINGS.jumper[${depth}].killGates must be integer ≥ ${min} ` +
363           `(got ${JSON.stringify(kg)}); never clamp`,
364       );
365       err.name = 'JumperKillGatesFloorError';
366       err.code = 'JUMPER_KILLGATES_FLOOR';
367       /** @type {any} */ (err).depth = depth;
368       /** @type {any} */ (err).killGates = kg;
369       /** @type {any} */ (err).min = min;
370       throw err;
371     }
372   }
373   return true;
374 }
375 
376 // Load-or-init: live jumper rows must satisfy the killGates floor (B3-SC3).
377 assertJumperKillGatesFloor(BAND_MAPPINGS.jumper);
378 
379 /**
380  * Load-or-init invariants for BAND_MAPPINGS.ramanujan (Track B4 SC1/SC2).
381  * Canonical row keys FULL|LITE|SPIKE only; LITE.certifier===false;
382  * LITE.verifyArms < FULL.verifyArms; every row integer verifyArms ≥ 1 + boolean certifier.
383  * Never clamps — throws.
384  *
385  * @param {Readonly<Record<string, Readonly<object>>> | Record<string, object>} [table]
386  * @returns {true}
387  */
388 export function assertRamanujanBandInvariants(table = BAND_MAPPINGS.ramanujan) {
389   if (!table || typeof table !== 'object') {
390     const err = new Error('BAND_MAPPINGS.ramanujan missing or not an object');
391     err.name = 'RamanujanBandInvariantError';
392     err.code = 'RAMANUJAN_BAND_INVARIANT';
393     throw err;
394   }
395   const keys = Object.keys(table);
396   const allowed = new Set(['FULL', 'LITE', 'SPIKE']);
397   if (keys.length !== 3 || keys.some((k) => !allowed.has(k))) {
398     const err = new Error(
399       `BAND_MAPPINGS.ramanujan keys must be exactly FULL|LITE|SPIKE (got ${JSON.stringify(keys)})`,
400     );
401     err.name = 'RamanujanBandInvariantError';
402     err.code = 'RAMANUJAN_BAND_INVARIANT';
403     /** @type {any} */ (err).keys = keys;
404     throw err;
405   }
406   for (const depth of keys) {
407     const row = table[depth];
408     const verifyArms = row && /** @type {{ verifyArms?: unknown }} */ (row).verifyArms;
409     const certifier = row && /** @type {{ certifier?: unknown }} */ (row).certifier;
410     if (!Number.isInteger(verifyArms) || /** @type {number} */ (verifyArms) < 1) {
411       const err = new Error(
412         `BAND_MAPPINGS.ramanujan[${depth}].verifyArms must be integer ≥ 1 (got ${JSON.stringify(verifyArms)})`,
413       );
414       err.name = 'RamanujanBandInvariantError';
415       err.code = 'RAMANUJAN_BAND_INVARIANT';
416       /** @type {any} */ (err).depth = depth;
417       throw err;
418     }
419     if (typeof certifier !== 'boolean') {
420       const err = new Error(
421         `BAND_MAPPINGS.ramanujan[${depth}].certifier must be boolean (got ${JSON.stringify(certifier)})`,
422       );
423       err.name = 'RamanujanBandInvariantError';
424       err.code = 'RAMANUJAN_BAND_INVARIANT';
425       /** @type {any} */ (err).depth = depth;
426       throw err;
427     }
428   }
429   const lite = /** @type {{ certifier?: unknown, verifyArms?: unknown }} */ (table.LITE);
430   const full = /** @type {{ verifyArms?: unknown }} */ (table.FULL);
431   if (lite.certifier !== false) {
432     const err = new Error(
433       `BAND_MAPPINGS.ramanujan.LITE.certifier must be false (got ${JSON.stringify(lite.certifier)})`,
434     );
435     err.name = 'RamanujanBandInvariantError';
436     err.code = 'RAMANUJAN_BAND_INVARIANT';
437     throw err;
438   }
439   if (
440     !(
441       Number.isInteger(lite.verifyArms) &&
442       Number.isInteger(full.verifyArms) &&
443       /** @type {number} */ (lite.verifyArms) < /** @type {number} */ (full.verifyArms)
444     )
445   ) {
446     const err = new Error(
447       `BAND_MAPPINGS.ramanujan LITE.verifyArms must be < FULL.verifyArms ` +
448         `(got LITE=${JSON.stringify(lite.verifyArms)} FULL=${JSON.stringify(full.verifyArms)})`,
449     );
450     err.name = 'RamanujanBandInvariantError';
451     err.code = 'RAMANUJAN_BAND_INVARIANT';
452     throw err;
453   }
454   return true;
455 }
456 
457 // Load-or-init: live ramanujan rows must satisfy B4 band invariants (SC1/SC2 floor).
458 assertRamanujanBandInvariants(BAND_MAPPINGS.ramanujan);

460 /**
461  * Ceremony lean-ness ordinal for zombie-hunter load asserts / leanness checks.
462  * Lower = leaner. Unknown tokens → null (caller hard-fails).
463  *
464  * @param {unknown} ceremonyOrLevel
465  * @returns {number | null}
466  */
467 export function ceremonyLevelOrdinal(ceremonyOrLevel) {
468   if (ceremonyOrLevel == null) return null;
469   const key = String(ceremonyOrLevel).trim().toLowerCase().replace(/_/g, '-');
470   if (key === 'lite' || key === 'light') return 0;
471   if (key === 'spike-first' || key === 'spike' || key === 'spikefirst') return 1;
472   if (key === 'full') return 2;
473   return null;
474 }
475 
476 /**
477  * Load-or-init invariants for BAND_MAPPINGS['zombie-hunter'] (Track B6 W1).
478  * Every row: requireProofOfDeath===true; integer reaperPasses ≥ REAPER_PASSES_MIN.
479  * LITE.reaperPasses < FULL.reaperPasses; LITE ceremony leaner than FULL.
480  * Never clamps — throws (a zero table cell fails load, not green after Math.max).
481  *
482  * @param {Readonly<Record<string, Readonly<object>>> | Record<string, object>} [table]
483  * @param {{ min?: number }} [opts]
484  * @returns {true}
485  */
486 export function assertZombieHunterBandInvariants(
487   table = BAND_MAPPINGS['zombie-hunter'],
488   opts = {},
489 ) {
490   const min = Number.isInteger(opts.min) ? opts.min : REAPER_PASSES_MIN;
491   if (!table || typeof table !== 'object') {
492     const err = new Error("BAND_MAPPINGS['zombie-hunter'] missing or not an object");
493     err.name = 'ZombieHunterBandInvariantError';
494     err.code = 'ZOMBIE_HUNTER_BAND_INVARIANT';
495     throw err;
496   }
497   const depths = Object.keys(table);
498   if (depths.length === 0) {
499     const err = new Error("BAND_MAPPINGS['zombie-hunter'] has no depth rows");
500     err.name = 'ZombieHunterBandInvariantError';
501     err.code = 'ZOMBIE_HUNTER_BAND_INVARIANT';
502     throw err;
503   }
504   for (const depth of depths) {
505     const row = table[depth];
506     const reaperPasses =
507       row && /** @type {{ reaperPasses?: unknown }} */ (row).reaperPasses;
508     const requireProofOfDeath =
509       row && /** @type {{ requireProofOfDeath?: unknown }} */ (row).requireProofOfDeath;
510     // Hard fail — never Math.max/clamp a thinned reaperPasses up to the floor.
511     if (!Number.isInteger(reaperPasses) || /** @type {number} */ (reaperPasses) < min) {
512       const err = new Error(
513         `BAND_MAPPINGS['zombie-hunter'][${depth}].reaperPasses must be integer ≥ ${min} ` +
514           `(got ${JSON.stringify(reaperPasses)}); never clamp`,
515       );
516       err.name = 'ZombieHunterBandInvariantError';
517       err.code = 'ZOMBIE_HUNTER_BAND_INVARIANT';
518       /** @type {any} */ (err).depth = depth;
519       /** @type {any} */ (err).reaperPasses = reaperPasses;
520       /** @type {any} */ (err).min = min;
521       throw err;
522     }
523     if (requireProofOfDeath !== true) {
524       const err = new Error(
525         `BAND_MAPPINGS['zombie-hunter'][${depth}].requireProofOfDeath must be true ` +
526           `(got ${JSON.stringify(requireProofOfDeath)}); never clamp green`,
527       );
528       err.name = 'ZombieHunterBandInvariantError';
529       err.code = 'ZOMBIE_HUNTER_BAND_INVARIANT';
530       /** @type {any} */ (err).depth = depth;
531       throw err;
532     }
533   }
534   const lite = /** @type {{ reaperPasses?: unknown, ceremony?: unknown }} */ (table.LITE);
535   const full = /** @type {{ reaperPasses?: unknown, ceremony?: unknown }} */ (table.FULL);
536   if (!lite || !full) {
537     const err = new Error(
538       "BAND_MAPPINGS['zombie-hunter'] must expose LITE and FULL rows for leanness asserts",
539     );
540     err.name = 'ZombieHunterBandInvariantError';
541     err.code = 'ZOMBIE_HUNTER_BAND_INVARIANT';
542     throw err;
543   }
544   if (
545     !(
546       Number.isInteger(lite.reaperPasses) &&
547       Number.isInteger(full.reaperPasses) &&
548       /** @type {number} */ (lite.reaperPasses) < /** @type {number} */ (full.reaperPasses)
549     )
550   ) {
551     const err = new Error(
552       `BAND_MAPPINGS['zombie-hunter'] LITE.reaperPasses must be < FULL.reaperPasses ` +
553         `(got LITE=${JSON.stringify(lite.reaperPasses)} FULL=${JSON.stringify(full.reaperPasses)})`,
554     );
555     err.name = 'ZombieHunterBandInvariantError';
556     err.code = 'ZOMBIE_HUNTER_BAND_INVARIANT';
557     throw err;
558   }
559   const liteOrd = ceremonyLevelOrdinal(lite.ceremony);
560   const fullOrd = ceremonyLevelOrdinal(full.ceremony);
561   if (liteOrd == null || fullOrd == null || !(liteOrd < fullOrd)) {
562     const err = new Error(
563       `BAND_MAPPINGS['zombie-hunter'] LITE ceremony must be leaner than FULL ` +
564         `(got LITE=${JSON.stringify(lite.ceremony)} FULL=${JSON.stringify(full.ceremony)})`,
565     );
566     err.name = 'ZombieHunterBandInvariantError';
567     err.code = 'ZOMBIE_HUNTER_BAND_INVARIANT';
568     throw err;
569   }
570   return true;
571 }
572 
573 // Load-or-init: live zombie-hunter rows must satisfy B6 band invariants (W1 floor).
574 assertZombieHunterBandInvariants(BAND_MAPPINGS['zombie-hunter']);

576 /**
577  * Load-or-init invariants for BAND_MAPPINGS['literature-review'] (Track B7 W1).
578  * Every row: integer snowballDepth ≥ 1, integer adversarialRounds ≥ 0.
579  * SC2 leaner soft-assert (no remap): LITE.snowballDepth < FULL.snowballDepth
580  *   || LITE.adversarialRounds < FULL.adversarialRounds.
581  * Hard-fail if a row embeds floor fields as false/0 (never Math.max/clamp-to-green).
582  *
583  * @param {Readonly<Record<string, Readonly<object>>> | Record<string, object>} [table]
584  * @returns {true}
585  */
586 export function assertLiteratureReviewBandInvariants(
587   table = BAND_MAPPINGS['literature-review'],
588 ) {
589   if (!table || typeof table !== 'object') {
590     const err = new Error("BAND_MAPPINGS['literature-review'] missing or not an object");
591     err.name = 'LiteratureReviewBandInvariantError';
592     err.code = 'LIT_REVIEW_BAND_INVARIANT';
593     throw err;
594   }
595   const depths = Object.keys(table);
596   if (depths.length === 0) {
597     const err = new Error("BAND_MAPPINGS['literature-review'] has no depth rows");
598     err.name = 'LiteratureReviewBandInvariantError';
599     err.code = 'LIT_REVIEW_BAND_INVARIANT';
600     throw err;
601   }
602   for (const depth of depths) {
603     const row = table[depth];
604     const snowballDepth =
605       row && /** @type {{ snowballDepth?: unknown }} */ (row).snowballDepth;
606     const adversarialRounds =
607       row && /** @type {{ adversarialRounds?: unknown }} */ (row).adversarialRounds;
608     // Hard fail — never Math.max/clamp a thinned snowballDepth up to 1.
609     if (!Number.isInteger(snowballDepth) || /** @type {number} */ (snowballDepth) < 1) {
610       const err = new Error(
611         `BAND_MAPPINGS['literature-review'][${depth}].snowballDepth must be integer ≥ 1 ` +
612           `(got ${JSON.stringify(snowballDepth)}); never clamp`,
613       );
614       err.name = 'LiteratureReviewBandInvariantError';
615       err.code = 'LIT_REVIEW_BAND_INVARIANT';
616       /** @type {any} */ (err).depth = depth;
617       /** @type {any} */ (err).snowballDepth = snowballDepth;
618       throw err;
619     }
620     if (!Number.isInteger(adversarialRounds) || /** @type {number} */ (adversarialRounds) < 0) {
621       const err = new Error(
622         `BAND_MAPPINGS['literature-review'][${depth}].adversarialRounds must be integer ≥ 0 ` +
623           `(got ${JSON.stringify(adversarialRounds)}); never clamp`,
624       );
625       err.name = 'LiteratureReviewBandInvariantError';
626       err.code = 'LIT_REVIEW_BAND_INVARIANT';
627       /** @type {any} */ (err).depth = depth;
628       /** @type {any} */ (err).adversarialRounds = adversarialRounds;
629       throw err;
630     }
631     // Floor fields must never be thinned on mapping rows (false/0 → hard fail).
632     const bag = /** @type {Record<string, unknown>} */ (row || {});
633     for (const key of LIT_REVIEW_FLOOR_FIELD_KEYS) {
634       if (!(key in bag)) continue;
635       const v = bag[key];
636       if (v === false || v === 0) {
637         const err = new Error(
638           `BAND_MAPPINGS['literature-review'][${depth}].${key} must not be false/0 ` +
639             `(got ${JSON.stringify(v)}); floor lives on LIT_REVIEW_SAFETY_FLOOR only`,
640         );
641         err.name = 'LiteratureReviewBandInvariantError';
642         err.code = 'LIT_REVIEW_BAND_INVARIANT';
643         /** @type {any} */ (err).depth = depth;
644         /** @type {any} */ (err).field = key;
645         /** @type {any} */ (err).value = v;
646         throw err;
647       }
648     }
649   }
650   const lite =
651     /** @type {{ snowballDepth?: unknown, adversarialRounds?: unknown }} */ (table.LITE);
652   const full =
653     /** @type {{ snowballDepth?: unknown, adversarialRounds?: unknown }} */ (table.FULL);
654   if (!lite || !full) {
655     const err = new Error(
656       "BAND_MAPPINGS['literature-review'] must expose LITE and FULL rows for leaner asserts",
657     );
658     err.name = 'LiteratureReviewBandInvariantError';
659     err.code = 'LIT_REVIEW_BAND_INVARIANT';
660     throw err;
661   }
662   // SC2 leaner soft-assert — never remap/rewrite cells to invent leanness.
663   const leaner =
664     (Number.isInteger(lite.snowballDepth) &&
665       Number.isInteger(full.snowballDepth) &&
666       /** @type {number} */ (lite.snowballDepth) < /** @type {number} */ (full.snowballDepth)) ||
667     (Number.isInteger(lite.adversarialRounds) &&
668       Number.isInteger(full.adversarialRounds) &&
669       /** @type {number} */ (lite.adversarialRounds) <
670         /** @type {number} */ (full.adversarialRounds));
671   if (!leaner) {
672     const err = new Error(
673       `BAND_MAPPINGS['literature-review'] LITE must be leaner than FULL on snowballDepth ` +
674         `or adversarialRounds (got LITE snowball=${JSON.stringify(lite.snowballDepth)} ` +
675         `rounds=${JSON.stringify(lite.adversarialRounds)}; FULL snowball=${JSON.stringify(full.snowballDepth)} ` +
676         `rounds=${JSON.stringify(full.adversarialRounds)}); never remap`,
677     );
678     err.name = 'LiteratureReviewBandInvariantError';
679     err.code = 'LIT_REVIEW_BAND_INVARIANT';
680     throw err;
681   }
682   return true;
683 }
684 
685 // Load-or-init: live literature-review rows must satisfy B7 band invariants (W1 floor + leaner).
686 assertLiteratureReviewBandInvariants(BAND_MAPPINGS['literature-review']);

688 /**
689  * Normalize skill id (case/alias tolerant for the full mapped set).
690  * @param {unknown} skill
691  * @returns {string | null}
692  */
693 export function normalizeMappedSkill(skill) {
694   if (typeof skill !== 'string' || !skill.trim()) return null;
695   const key = skill.trim().toLowerCase().replace(/_/g, '-');
696   if (key === 'crucible') return 'crucible';
697   if (key === 'foreman') return 'foreman';
698   if (key === 'researchprime' || key === 'research-prime') return 'researchPrime';
699   if (key === 'gandalf') return 'gandalf';
700   if (key === 'jumper') return 'jumper';
701   if (key === 'ramanujan') return 'ramanujan';
702   if (key === 'tidy-idy' || key === 'tidyidy' || key === 'tidy') return 'tidy-idy';
703   if (key === 'zombie-hunter' || key === 'zombiehunter' || key === 'zombie') {
704     return 'zombie-hunter';
705   }
706   if (key === 'literature-review' || key === 'literaturereview' || key === 'lit-review') {
707     return 'literature-review';
708   }
709   if (key === 'financial-analyst' || key === 'financialanalyst' || key === 'fin-analyst') {
710     return 'financial-analyst';
711   }
712   if (key === 'legal-beagle' || key === 'legalbeagle' || key === 'legal') return 'legal-beagle';
713   return null;
714 }

716 /**
717  * Resolve knobs for a skill + locked (or free-form) depth + optional tier.
718  * Tier overlays `seats` when provided (Heavy → frontier, Standard → standard)
719  * without erasing other depth knobs. Unknown skill/depth → null.
720  *
721  * @param {unknown} skill
722  * @param {unknown} depth
723  * @param {unknown} [tier]
724  * @returns {Readonly<object> | null}
725  */
726 export function knobsForSkill(skill, depth, tier) {
727   const skillId = normalizeMappedSkill(skill);
728   if (!skillId) return null;
729   const table = BAND_MAPPINGS[skillId];
730   if (!table) return null;
731   // Canonicalize first so SPIKE-FIRST locks and SPIKE operator tokens hit the SPIKE row.
732   const d =
733     canonicalizeDepth(depth) ??
734     (isProcessDepth(depth) ? /** @type {string} */ (depth) : normalizeDepth(depth));
735   if (!d) return null;
736   const row = table[d] ?? (d === DEPTH_BANDS.SPIKE ? table['SPIKE-FIRST'] : null);
737   if (!row) return null;
738 
739   const base = { ...row, skill: skillId, depth: d === 'SPIKE-FIRST' ? DEPTH_BANDS.SPIKE : d };
740   const t = isModelTier(tier) ? tier : normalizeTier(tier);
741   if (t) {
742     base.tier = t;
743     // Visible tier overlay: Heavy keeps/raises frontier seats; Standard leans standard.
744     // Does not silently invent a lock — caller must already hold a lock to apply knobs.
745     if (t === MODEL_TIERS.STANDARD) base.seats = 'standard';
746     else if (t === MODEL_TIERS.HEAVY) base.seats = 'frontier';
747   }
748   return Object.freeze(base);
749 }
750

776 /**
777  * Sole resolve path for jumper depth → ideaRounds / killGates (B3 SC1).
778  *
779  * Pipeline (locked):
780  *   1. normalizeDepth (strict) → canonical LITE | SPIKE | FULL (aliases → SPIKE)
781  *   2. read **only** BAND_MAPPINGS.jumper via jumperKnobs (no path-local map)
782  *   3. assert killGates ≥ JUMPER_KILL_GATES_MIN (never clamp)
783  *   4. return { depth, ideaRounds, killGates }
784  *
785  * Tier is intentionally not accepted: ideaRounds/killGates are depth-only
786  * (B3-SC1-TIER-INERT). Unknown depth hard-fails with accepted set named.
787  *
788  * @param {unknown} depth
789  * @returns {Readonly<{ depth: string, ideaRounds: number, killGates: number }>}
790  */
791 export function resolveJumperDepthKnobs(depth) {
792   // Hard-fail unknown so production CLI can exit≠0 with accepted set on stderr.
793   const d = normalizeDepthStrict(depth);
794   // Sole table read — jumperKnobs → knobsForSkill('jumper') → BAND_MAPPINGS.jumper.
795   const knobs = jumperKnobs(d);
796   if (!knobs) {
797     const err = new Error(
798       `BAND_MAPPINGS.jumper has no row for depth ${JSON.stringify(d)}; ` +
799         `accepted: ${ACCEPTED_DEPTH_SET.join(' | ')}`,
800     );
801     err.name = 'UnknownDepthError';
802     err.code = 'TRIAGE_UNKNOWN_DEPTH';
803     /** @type {any} */ (err).accepted = [...ACCEPTED_DEPTH_SET];
804     throw err;
805   }
806   const ideaRounds = /** @type {{ ideaRounds?: unknown }} */ (knobs).ideaRounds;
807   const killGates = /** @type {{ killGates?: unknown }} */ (knobs).killGates;
808   // Per-resolve floor — never Math.max/clamp a thinned value.
809   if (!Number.isInteger(killGates) || /** @type {number} */ (killGates) < JUMPER_KILL_GATES_MIN) {
810     const err = new Error(
811       `jumper killGates for ${d} must be integer ≥ ${JUMPER_KILL_GATES_MIN} ` +
812         `(got ${JSON.stringify(killGates)}); never clamp`,
813     );
814     err.name = 'JumperKillGatesFloorError';
815     err.code = 'JUMPER_KILLGATES_FLOOR';
816     /** @type {any} */ (err).depth = d;
817     /** @type {any} */ (err).killGates = killGates;
818     throw err;
819   }
820   if (!Number.isInteger(ideaRounds) || /** @type {number} */ (ideaRounds) < 1) {
821     const err = new Error(
822       `jumper ideaRounds for ${d} must be a positive integer (got ${JSON.stringify(ideaRounds)})`,
823     );
824     err.name = 'JumperIdeaRoundsError';
825     err.code = 'JUMPER_IDEA_ROUNDS';
826     /** @type {any} */ (err).depth = d;
827     throw err;
828   }
829   return Object.freeze({
830     depth: d,
831     ideaRounds: /** @type {number} */ (ideaRounds),
832     killGates: /** @type {number} */ (killGates),
833   });
834 }

1073 /**
1074  * Resolve literature-review band + knobs + floor (Track B7 W1 control plane).
1075  *
1076  * Precedence (band only — first match wins after normalize):
1077  *   1. options.confirmedDepth / options.depth / intake lock depth
1078  *   2. process.env.FOUNDRY_TRIAGE_DEPTH (or opts.env)
1079  *   3. process.env.LITREVIEW_TRIAGE_DEPTH
1080  *   4. missing → mapped FULL with source 'default-full' (finite knobs, not a soft lock claim)
1081  *
1082  * Unknown token → LIT_REVIEW_UNKNOWN_DEPTH (refuse-closed).
1083  * When band is locked (rank 1–2 or lock stamp) and caller supplies snowballDepth /
1084  * adversarialRounds that differ from literatureReviewKnobs(band) →
1085  * LIT_REVIEW_PARTIAL_OVERRIDE_REFUSED.
1086  *
1087  * @param {object} [opts]
1088  * @param {unknown} [opts.confirmedDepth]
1089  * @param {unknown} [opts.depth]
1090  * @param {unknown} [opts.snowballDepth] explicit freestyle / desync probe
1091  * @param {unknown} [opts.adversarialRounds] explicit freestyle / desync probe
1092  * @param {object} [opts.triageLock]
1093  * @param {object} [opts.lock]
1094  * @param {object} [opts.intake]
1095  * @param {NodeJS.ProcessEnv | Record<string, string | undefined>} [opts.env]
1096  * @returns {Readonly<{
1097  *   source: string,
1098  *   band: string,
1099  *   reason: string,
1100  *   knobs: Readonly<{
1101  *     depth: string,
1102  *     snowballDepth: number,
1103  *     adversarialRounds: number,
1104  *     ceremony: string,
1105  *     seats: string,
1106  *     skill: 'literature-review',
1107  *   }>,
1108  *   floor: typeof LIT_REVIEW_SAFETY_FLOOR,
1109  * }>}
1110  */
1111 export function resolveLiteratureReviewBand({
1112   confirmedDepth = null,
1113   depth = null,
1114   snowballDepth = undefined,
1115   adversarialRounds = undefined,
1116   triageLock = null,
1117   lock = null,
1118   intake = null,
1119   env = process.env,
1120 } = {}) {
1121   /** @type {string | null} */
1122   let picked = null;
1123   /** @type {string} */
1124   let source = 'default-full';
1125   /** @type {string} */
1126   let reason = 'no depth pin; mapped FULL default (finite knobs, not a lock claim)';
1127   /** @type {boolean} */
1128   let bandLocked = false;
1129 
1130   const confirmedPin = litReviewNonEmptyToken(confirmedDepth) || litReviewNonEmptyToken(depth);
1131   if (confirmedPin) {
1132     picked = confirmedPin;
1133     source = 'confirmed-depth';
1134     reason = `confirmedDepth/depth pin ${JSON.stringify(confirmedPin)}`;
1135     bandLocked = true;
1136   }
1137 
1138   if (picked == null) {
1139     const explicit = triageLock ?? lock ?? null;
1140     if (explicit != null && typeof explicit === 'object') {
1141       const bag = /** @type {Record<string, unknown>} */ (explicit);
1142       const lockDepth =
1143         litReviewNonEmptyToken(bag.depth) ||
1144         (bag.locked === true ? litReviewNonEmptyToken(bag.depth) : null);
1145       if (lockDepth) {
1146         picked = lockDepth;
1147         source = 'lock-record';
1148         reason = `lock/triageLock depth ${JSON.stringify(lockDepth)}`;
1149         bandLocked = true;
1150       }
1151     }
1152   }
1153 
1154   if (picked == null && intake != null && typeof intake === 'object') {
1155     const bag = /** @type {Record<string, unknown>} */ (intake);
1156     if (bag.lock != null && typeof bag.lock === 'object') {
1157       const lockBag = /** @type {Record<string, unknown>} */ (bag.lock);
1158       const lockDepth = litReviewNonEmptyToken(lockBag.depth);
1159       if (lockDepth) {
1160         picked = lockDepth;
1161         source = 'lock-record';
1162         reason = `intake.lock depth ${JSON.stringify(lockDepth)}`;
1163         bandLocked = true;
1164       }
1165     }
1166     if (picked == null) {
1167       const intakeDepth =
1168         litReviewNonEmptyToken(bag.confirmedDepth) || litReviewNonEmptyToken(bag.depth);
1169       if (intakeDepth) {
1170         picked = intakeDepth;
1171         source = 'confirmed-depth';
1172         reason = `intake confirmedDepth/depth ${JSON.stringify(intakeDepth)}`;
1173         bandLocked = true;
1174       }
1175     }
1176   }
1177 
1178   const e = env && typeof env === 'object' ? env : {};
1179   if (picked == null) {
1180     const foundry = litReviewNonEmptyToken(
1181       /** @type {Record<string, unknown>} */ (e).FOUNDRY_TRIAGE_DEPTH,
1182     );
1183     if (foundry) {
1184       picked = foundry;
1185       source = 'foundry-triage-depth';
1186       reason = `FOUNDRY_TRIAGE_DEPTH=${JSON.stringify(foundry)}`;
1187       // Rank-2 portfolio lock — partial override refused while advertised.
1188       bandLocked = true;
1189     }
1190   }
1191   if (picked == null) {
1192     const skillLocal = litReviewNonEmptyToken(
1193       /** @type {Record<string, unknown>} */ (e).LITREVIEW_TRIAGE_DEPTH,
1194     );
1195     if (skillLocal) {
1196       picked = skillLocal;
1197       source = 'litreview-triage-depth';
1198       reason = `LITREVIEW_TRIAGE_DEPTH=${JSON.stringify(skillLocal)}`;
1199       // Rank-3 skill pin — not FOUNDRY lock advertising; freestyle still allowed off-gate.
1200       bandLocked = false;
1201     }
1202   }
1203 
1204   const depthToken = picked || 'FULL';
1205   if (picked == null) {
1206     source = 'default-full';
1207     reason = 'no depth pin; mapped FULL default (finite knobs, not a lock claim)';
1208     bandLocked = false;
1209   }
1210 
1211   // Unknown → refuse-closed (LIT_REVIEW_UNKNOWN_DEPTH); never silent FULL that claims lock.
1212   const band = normalizeLiteratureReviewDepthStrict(depthToken);
1213   const knobs = literatureReviewKnobs(band);
1214   if (!knobs) {
1215     const err = new Error(
1216       `BAND_MAPPINGS['literature-review'] has no row for depth ${JSON.stringify(band)}; ` +
1217         `accepted: ${ACCEPTED_DEPTH_SET.join(' | ')}`,
1218     );
1219     err.name = 'LiteratureReviewUnknownDepthError';
1220     err.code = LIT_REVIEW_UNKNOWN_DEPTH;
1221     /** @type {any} */ (err).accepted = [...ACCEPTED_DEPTH_SET];
1222     /** @type {any} */ (err).band = band;
1223     throw err;
1224   }
1225 
1226   // Partial-override refuse while lock is advertised (rank 1–2 / lock stamp).
1227   if (bandLocked) {
1228     if (snowballDepth !== undefined && snowballDepth !== null) {
1229       const got = Number(snowballDepth);
1230       if (!(Number.isInteger(got) && got === knobs.snowballDepth)) {
1231         throw literatureReviewPartialOverrideError(
1232           'snowballDepth',
1233           snowballDepth,
1234           knobs.snowballDepth,
1235           band,
1236         );
1237       }
1238     }
1239     if (adversarialRounds !== undefined && adversarialRounds !== null) {
1240       const got = Number(adversarialRounds);
1241       if (!(Number.isInteger(got) && got === knobs.adversarialRounds)) {
1242         throw literatureReviewPartialOverrideError(
1243           'adversarialRounds',
1244           adversarialRounds,
1245           knobs.adversarialRounds,
1246           band,
1247         );
1248       }
1249     }
1250   }
1251 
1252   return Object.freeze({
1253     source,
1254     band,
1255     reason,
1256     knobs,
1257     floor: LIT_REVIEW_SAFETY_FLOOR,
1258   });
1259 }
1260

1263   return knobsForSkill('financial-analyst', depth, tier);

1271 /**
1272  * JSON-stable fingerprint of knobs for inequality tests (order-independent enough).
1273  * @param {unknown} knobs
1274  * @returns {string}
1275  */
1276 export function knobsFingerprint(knobs) {
1277   if (!knobs || typeof knobs !== 'object') return '';
1278   const o = /** @type {Record<string, unknown>} */ (knobs);
1279   const keys = Object.keys(o).sort();
1280   const sorted = {};
1281   for (const k of keys) sorted[k] = o[k];
1282   return JSON.stringify(sorted);
1283 }
1284 
1285 /**
1286  * True when two bands produce unequal knobs for a skill (NS criterion 6).
1287  * @param {string} skill
1288  * @param {string} depthA
1289  * @param {string} depthB
1290  * @returns {boolean}
1291  */
1292 export function bandsInequal(skill, depthA, depthB) {
1293   const a = knobsForSkill(skill, depthA);
1294   const b = knobsForSkill(skill, depthB);
1295   if (!a || !b) return false;
1296   return knobsFingerprint(a) !== knobsFingerprint(b);
1297 }
